title: Beloch: origami folding sequences as programs
description: Beloch evaluates a program, a sequence of Huzita-Justin constructions and folds, into a FOLD file with the folded state after every step. The evaluator works over an exact real-algebraic number kernel, so constructed coincidences hold exactly rather than within a tolerance, and emits the FOLD interchange format.
